meta_data.base_class: Explores unique relationship traits of individuals with <a specific zodiac sign>. - This is an application that analyzes the behavior of a specific zodiac sign across different relationship types (e.g., friendship, love, family, work).

tool_template.name: <class>_relationship_traits
tool_template.description: Explore unique relationship traits of individuals with the <class> zodiac sign.

relationship_type.description: Type of relationship to explore for a <class> (e.g., friendship, love, family, work).

gender_focus.description: Specifies the gender for the analysis of the <class>. Choose from 'male', 'female', or 'both'.

analysis_focus.description: The specific aspect of the relationship to focus the analysis on for the <class>. Options include 'strengths', 'challenges', 'compatibility_summary', or 'communication_tips'.

analysis_depth.description: The level of detail required for the analysis of the <class> traits. Options include 'summary', 'detailed_report', or 'bullet_points'.

decan.description: Specifies the decan (1, 2, or 3) of the <class> zodiac sign for a more nuanced analysis. Options are 1, 2, or 3.
